pages.text: A $(item)rift sieve$() on a conduit's end chooses what passes. I name things from what I carry: only these, or all but these. A bare hand on that end opens it again.
The $(item)greater sieve$() also tells a thing from its twin: the enchanted from the plain, the named from the nameless.

pages.title: Fluids
pages.text: On a fluid conduit a sieve works the same way, and I show it the fluid's $(thing)bucket$().$(br2)A sieve that names nothing lets everything through. Breaking the conduit gives the sieve back.
A $(item)surge crystal$() on a pulling end makes it move four times as much. Up to three on one end. Crouch with the tuner to take them back.
